summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned ComplexPrint homepage (corporate B2B redesign + navy/amber palette). All required sections render (with IntersectionObserver-based lazy mount), all data-testid hooks resolve, task-selector cards navigate to the four service routes, hero CTAs work (calc scrolls to corporate-request section; engineer is tel:+79911857289), trust block shows 4 stats and 25 client chips, corporate-request form disables submit until required fields + terms are checked (form-level validation via disabled submit rather than inline error text), submitting posts to /api/send-repair-request (in preview returns 502 as expected) and a user-facing error message is shown: 'Не удалось отправить заявку. Пожалуйста, позвоните нам по телефону +79911857289'. Header CTA opens the repair modal (data-testid=repair-request-modal). PrivateClientPath section: request CTA opens modal, call CTA is tel:+79911857289, details link goes to /razovyy-remont. Mobile 390x844: mobile-contact-bar visible with mobile-bar-call (tel) and mobile-bar-request (opens modal); hamburger (aria-label='Меню') opens/closes drawer with header-mobile-cta-repair-request; no horizontal scroll on / or /ceny. Internal pages /ceny, /faq, /about-us, /remont-printerov-hp, /analytics load without console errors after the global color-class refactor.

issues: 'Заказать' button uses a red→orange gradient which appears to include red tones; the approved palette says red only for errors — worth double-checking that this button is pure amber (signal) and not the old red gradient.

action_items: Minor: React DOM warning in console — 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority'. Occurs on every route. Somewhere JSX passes fetchpriority (lowercase) to an /. Rename attribute to fetchPriority (camelCase) to silence the warning.

Optional UX: currently empty-form submit is prevented by disabling the submit button. Spec wording says 'submitting empty shows a visible error message'. Consider showing inline field errors on blur/attempted submit for better a11y, in addition to disabling the button.
Verify /ceny 'Заказать' button color — appears to have a red-orange gradient; ensure only the amber (signal) accent is used, per the approved palette.
critical_code_review_comments: Client-side error handling in RepairRequestFormBody correctly surfaces the network failure with a phone-number fallback message — good pattern for the preview vs prod split.

Home sections use IntersectionObserver-based lazy mount, so a top-level snapshot right after page load will not find corporate-request/private-client/trust-* nodes. Fine for real users, but tests must scroll the page first. Consider setting rootMargin so the sections mount slightly earlier (or hydrate on idle) to prevent CLS on slow devices.
Console: 'fetchpriority' React warning – fix by using fetchPriority (camelCase) on the offending /.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://seo-audit-check-5.preview.emergentagent.com. Cookie banner must be dismissed first ('Только необходимые'). Home page uses IntersectionObserver — must scroll down (e.g., window.scrollTo through y=1200..8400) before querying trust-*/corporate-request/private-client data-testids. Form submit posts to /api/send-repair-request which returns 502 in preview (expected). Modal element uses data-testid=repair-request-modal (rendered via portal; offsetParent may be null even when visible — check bounding rect/visibility differently). Mobile hamburger is button[aria-label='Меню']. No backend in this environment.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. The one recurring console error 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' is a React warning caused by using the HTML attribute name in JSX; rename to fetchPriority (camelCase) in the offending component (likely a hero or a preload ).
